import EnvTable from '../../../../components/EnvTable.astro';
import { Aside } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

<Aside type="caution" title="NEXT_PUBLIC_ values are public and fixed at build time">
Next.js inlines every `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` variable into the build, in the browser
bundle and on the server alike. Never put a secret there, and pass them as
Docker build arguments: an image is pinned to the values it was built with.
</Aside>

Generation creates `.env` from `.env.example` and fills `PAYLOAD_SECRET` and
`PREVIEW_SECRET` with random values (`yarn env:init` does the same later).
